note: All player-facing UI text lives here so a localisation is a data change, not a code change. English ships; the keys are stable. Story dialogue lives in the scene scripts, which are localised the same way.

strings.game.title: Qing Mao · Rebirth
strings.game.subtitle: Reverend Insanity · chapters 1–200
strings.game.tagline: A second life. The same resolve.
strings.game.intro: Five hundred years of memory. A mountain village. One chance to begin again.
strings.game.blurb: Two hundred chapters of the Qing Mao arc: the rebirth, the awakening, the Liquor worm and the cave, the academy, the inheritance trials, the year-end duel, the winter crossing, the family assets, the wolf tide, the investigation, and the night the mountain came apart. Every chapter is played, staged, or recorded in his own ledger.
strings.game.newGamePlus: Another turn of spring and autumn
strings.notice.heading: Before you begin
strings.notice.body: This story contains violence, cruelty, death and mass death, and many of the people involved are teenagers. Decisions and consequences happen on screen; violence is cut away from, and the aftermath is shown through places and people rather than detail. You can set the intensity now or at any time, and neither setting changes what happens in the story.

strings.errata.title: Report a canon issue
strings.errata.note: Your note is filed with the scene and the chapter attached, which is what makes it easy to act on.
strings.previously.title: Previously
strings.refine.title: Refinement
strings.refine.canonSafe: This refinement is part of the story. It cannot fail outright — a bad attempt costs days and stones.
strings.refine.canFail: This is an optional recipe. It can fail and take its materials with it.
strings.refine.delay: It did not take. {days} days and {stones} stones gone; the materials are intact.
strings.shortfall.title: Short by {n} stones
strings.shortfall.note: The payment goes through. How you make up the difference is yours to choose.
strings.storage.persistNote: Progress is stored in this browser.
strings.storage.iosWarning: On iPhone and iPad, Safari clears a site's saved data after seven days without a visit. Adding this game to your Home Screen exempts it, and is the only reliable way to keep a long save.
strings.webgl.title: This game needs WebGL2
strings.webgl.body: WebGL2 ships in current Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari 15 and later. Updating your browser, or turning hardware acceleration back on, should be enough.
strings.ending.note: Exports a Legacy file and stores it for this site. The next game reads it at its start, and plays perfectly well without it.
